text_block_list.text:
You overtook me... You really are
strong, Taishin.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You're so strong, but you still believe in
me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: YЭпизод I do.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Heh.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Taishin!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: That's no fair!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
We suddenly hear Уиннинг Тикит
yelling as
they're on the way back to the
academy.
No fair, no fair, no fair, no faaair! It's not cool how well you two are getting along!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I wanna race with you guys toooo!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Uh, you've only got yourself to blame
for getting
injured.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Now, now. No need to cry.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The three of us are still in the Twinkle
Series.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Which means we can race against each
other as
often as we wish to.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Isn't that right?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Aww, Hayahide!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Waaaah! That is right!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Oooh, I know! Let's all race in the
autumn Tenno
Sho!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: It'll be a BNW reunion!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Are you seriously not embarrassed using
that
name?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The three of them vow to race together
at the
autumn Tenno Sho before parting
ways.
